maintenance_led.reason: Most revenue is new instruments, reagents/consumables, and CDMO/CRO services; instrument service is a smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are pharma, biotech, diagnostics, industrial and academic labs; government funding is a minority share.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through products and services, with occasional large deals like PPD and Patheon.

mission_critical.reason: Qualified instruments, validated workflows, and CDMO/CRO programs under regulatory approval make switching costly and risky.
